 Actor Ko Kyung-pyo Investigated for Drunk Driving Accident with Revocation-Level Blood Alcohol Content
 So Hwan-uk 
 Seoul 
 Published 
 2026.11.14 11:55 
 View 
 View Count 
 PIP 닫기 
 Actor Ko Kyung-pyo is currently under police investigation for getting into a traffic accident while driving under the influence. 
 Around 3:30 AM today (November 14), Ko collided with a garbage truck while driving his passenger car in Donggyo-dong, Mapo-gu, Seoul. 
 A breathalyzer test revealed that Ko's blood alcohol concentration was 0.08% or higher, which falls under the threshold for license revocation. 
 It was reported that there were no passengers in the vehicle with Ko at the time of the accident. 
 After administering a breathalyzer test, police sent Ko home and are currently investigating whether there were any injuries and looking into the exact details of the accident. 
 Ko's agency released an official statement offering a deep apology to those who suffered damage, stating that Ko "acknowledges his fault and is deeply reflecting on his actions." 
 The agency added that he will humbly accept any future disciplinary measures, fulfill his responsibilities including recovery for the damage, and pay closer attention to managing their actors to prevent such incidents from happening again. 
 Ko, who debuted in 2010, has built recognition by appearing in popular dramas and variety shows. 
 He has remained active in various fields recently, with upcoming programs scheduled for release.
